decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already restricts eligible winners and draw state to the new active contract while excluding old-contract NFTs and tickets.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already records that draws and ticket accounting start with the new active contract and exclude old-contract NFTs from the active system.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already updates the FAQ's referral, prize-ticket, and NFT-transfer descriptions to exclude old-contract copies and use the new active contract.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits random no-code reward recipients to NFT holders in the new active contract.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already makes old-contract mint numbers invalid and limits valid referral codes to NFTs minted by the new active contract.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already establishes new-contract mint numbers beginning at NFT #1 as referral codes and excludes old-contract mint numbers.
Restarting NFTs and draws under the new contract does not change the established funding sources, allocation, duration, or active Small Block prize pool.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already scopes dashboard referral rewards and prize-ticket accounting to the new active contract and excludes old-contract data.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits project dashboard visibility to NFTs from the new active contract and excludes old-contract copies.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits public referral aggregates to new-contract activity and excludes old-contract NFT referral data.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already requires mint and supply statistics to restart from NFT #1 for the new active contract and exclude old-contract copies.

The contract migration does not change which Small Block ticket counter, badges, or referral-code fields must be visible in metadata; old-contract metadata may continue to exist even though those NFTs are excluded from active project systems.
